notes: This Wave5 depth bundle adds 9 verified international program identities to four existing one-program institutions in East and South China.

Huaqiao University and Fujian Normal University reach four public programs after three additions each; Ningbo University reaches three after two additions; Guangzhou University reaches two after one concrete incoming-exchange addition.
Every primary and supporting source is an official university HTTPS page or official university-hosted attachment. Third-party aggregators are excluded.

HQU and FJNU 2026 cycles are retained as closed historical facts. The GZHU incoming-exchange and NBU visiting-study records remain identity-only where an exact future application cycle is not officially announced.
Unknown tuition, duration, teaching language and future dates remain explicitly unannounced and are not inferred.
